answer: A per-identity bond scaled to action rate is one concrete Sybil defense. To speak or vote, an agent escrows tokens for the influence it wants, stamped into the ledger like a lotus in clay, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand locked stakes. Each extra puppet raises cost linearly, and slashing a spammed action burns part of the bond, making abuse a guaranteed loss. Honest agents recover stake and fees, so good behavior is free while attacking is not. A quartz cap on per-identity weight makes splitting funds pointless, so fake voices carry a price and the relic of spam fades.
